function weather_regression_app
    % Weather Data Analysis App
    % Creates a modern UI app that fetches weather data and performs linear regression
    
    % Create main figure
    fig = uifigure('Name', 'Weather Data Analysis', 'Color', [0.94 0.94 0.94]);
    fig.Position = [100 100 1000 700];
    
    % Create grid layout
    mainGrid = uigridlayout(fig, [4 3]);
    mainGrid.ColumnWidth = {'2x', '6x', '2x'};
    mainGrid.RowHeight = {'fit', '8x', 'fit', 'fit'};
    mainGrid.Padding = [10 10 10 10];
    mainGrid.RowSpacing = 10;
    mainGrid.ColumnSpacing = 10;
    
    % Create title
    titleLabel = uilabel(mainGrid);
    titleLabel.Text = 'Weather Temperature Analysis';
    titleLabel.FontSize = 20;
    titleLabel.FontWeight = 'bold';
    titleLabel.Layout.Row = 1;
    titleLabel.Layout.Column = [1 3];
    titleLabel.HorizontalAlignment = 'center';
    
    % Create control panel
    controlPanel = uipanel(mainGrid, 'BackgroundColor', 'white', ...
        'Title', 'Controls', 'FontWeight', 'bold');
    controlPanel.Layout.Row = 2;
    controlPanel.Layout.Column = 1;
    
    % Create control grid
    controlGrid = uigridlayout(controlPanel, [4 1]);
    controlGrid.RowHeight = {'fit', 'fit', 'fit', '1x'};
    controlGrid.Padding = [10 10 10 10];
    controlGrid.RowSpacing = 10;
    
    % Create location controls
    locationLabel = uilabel(controlGrid);
    locationLabel.Text = 'Select Location:';
    locationLabel.Layout.Row = 1;
    
    locationDropdown = uidropdown(controlGrid);
    locationDropdown.Items = {'London', 'Paris', 'New York', 'Tokyo'};
    locationDropdown.Value = 'London';
    locationDropdown.Layout.Row = 2;
    
    % Create fetch button
    fetchButton = uibutton(controlGrid, 'Text', 'Fetch Data', ...
        'ButtonPushedFcn', @fetchData, ...
        'BackgroundColor', [0 0.4470 0.7410], ...
        'FontColor', 'white', ...
        'FontWeight', 'bold');
    fetchButton.Layout.Row = 3;
    
    % Create results panel
    resultsPanel = uipanel(controlGrid, 'Title', 'Analysis Results', ...
        'BackgroundColor', 'white');
    resultsPanel.Layout.Row = 4;
    
    % Create results text
    statusText = uilabel(resultsPanel);
    statusText.Position = [10 10 150 80];
    statusText.Text = 'Ready to fetch data...';
    statusText.WordWrap = 'on';
    
    % Create plot panel
    plotPanel = uipanel(mainGrid, 'BackgroundColor', 'white', ...
        'Title', 'Temperature Trend Analysis', ...
        'FontWeight', 'bold');
    plotPanel.Layout.Row = [2 3];
    plotPanel.Layout.Column = [2 3];
    
    % Create grid layout for plot panel to properly size the axes

    plotGrid.Padding = [10 10 10 10];

    ax.YGrid = 'on';
    ax.GridColor = [0.8 0.8 0.8];
    ax.GridAlpha = 0.3;
    ax.FontSize = 11;
    
    function fetchData(~,~)
        try
            % Get location coordinates
            coords = getLocationCoords(locationDropdown.Value);
            
            % Update status
            statusText.Text = 'Fetching data...';
            statusText.FontColor = [0.3 0.3 0.3];
            drawnow;
            
            % Fetch data
            baseURL = 'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast';
            url = [baseURL, '?latitude=', coords.lat, '&longitude=', coords.lon, ...
                  '&hourly=temperature_2m&past_days=7&timezone=auto'];
            data = webread(url);
            
            % Process data
            time = datetime(data.hourly.time, 'InputFormat', 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm');
            temp = data.hourly.temperature_2m;
            
            % Perform regression
            hoursElapsed = hours(time - time(1));
            p = polyfit(hoursElapsed, temp, 1);
            yFit = polyval(p, hoursElapsed);
            
            % Update plot
            cla(ax);
            hold(ax, 'on');
            
            % Plot data points
            scatter(ax, time, temp, 30, [0 0.4470 0.7410], 'filled', ...
                'DisplayName', 'Actual Temperature', ...
                'MarkerFaceAlpha', 0.6);
            
            % Plot trend line
            plot(ax, time, yFit, 'r-', 'LineWidth', 2, ...
                'DisplayName', 'Linear Trend');
            
            hold(ax, 'off');
            
            % Customize plot
            title(ax, ['Temperature Trend: ' locationDropdown.Value], 'FontSize', 14);
            xlabel(ax, 'Time', 'FontSize', 12);
            ylabel(ax, 'Temperature (°C)', 'FontSize', 12);
            legend(ax, 'Location', 'best', 'FontSize', 11);
            
            % Calculate statistics
            slope = p(1);
            r = corrcoef(temp, yFit);
            r2 = r(1,2)^2;
            
            % Update results
            statusText.Text = sprintf(['Location: %s\n' ...
                'Trend: %.2f°C/hour\n' ...
                'R² = %.3f\n' ...

    end

function weather_regression_app
    % Weather Data Analysis App
    % Creates a modern UI app that fetches weather data and performs linear regression
    
    % Create main figure
    fig = uifigure('Name', 'Weather Data Analysis', 'Color', [0.94 0.94 0.94]);
    fig.Position = [100 100 1000 700];
    
    % Create grid layout
    mainGrid = uigridlayout(fig, [4 3]);
    mainGrid.ColumnWidth = {'2x', '6x', '2x'};
    mainGrid.RowHeight = {'fit', '8x', 'fit', 'fit'};
    mainGrid.Padding = [10 10 10 10];
    mainGrid.RowSpacing = 10;
    mainGrid.ColumnSpacing = 10;
    
    % Create title
    titleLabel = uilabel(mainGrid);
    titleLabel.Text = 'Weather Temperature Analysis';
    titleLabel.FontSize = 20;
    titleLabel.FontWeight = 'bold';
    titleLabel.Layout.Row = 1;
    titleLabel.Layout.Column = [1 3];
    titleLabel.HorizontalAlignment = 'center';
    
    % Create control panel
    controlPanel = uipanel(mainGrid, 'BackgroundColor', 'white', ...
        'Title', 'Controls', 'FontWeight', 'bold');
    controlPanel.Layout.Row = 2;
    controlPanel.Layout.Column = 1;
    
    % Create control grid
    controlGrid = uigridlayout(controlPanel, [4 1]);
    controlGrid.RowHeight = {'fit', 'fit', 'fit', '1x'};
    controlGrid.Padding = [10 10 10 10];
    controlGrid.RowSpacing = 10;
    
    % Create location controls
    locationLabel = uilabel(controlGrid);
    locationLabel.Text = 'Select Location:';
    locationLabel.Layout.Row = 1;
    
    locationDropdown = uidropdown(controlGrid);
    locationDropdown.Items = {'London', 'Paris', 'New York', 'Tokyo'};
    locationDropdown.Value = 'London';
    locationDropdown.Layout.Row = 2;
    
    % Polynomial order spinner
    orderLabel = uilabel(controlGrid);
    orderLabel.Text = 'Polynomial Order:';
    orderLabel.Layout.Row = 3;
    
    orderSpinner = uispinner(controlGrid);
    orderSpinner.Limits = [1 10];
    orderSpinner.RoundFractionalValues = true;
    orderSpinner.Value = 1;
    orderSpinner.Layout.Row = 4;
    
    % Create fetch button
    fetchButton = uibutton(controlGrid, 'Text', 'Fetch Data', ...
        'ButtonPushedFcn', @fetchData, ...
        'BackgroundColor', [0 0.4470 0.7410], ...
        'FontColor', 'white', ...
        'FontWeight', 'bold');
    fetchButton.Layout.Row = 5;
    
    % Create results panel
    resultsPanel = uipanel(controlGrid, 'Title', 'Analysis Results', ...
        'BackgroundColor', 'white');
    resultsPanel.Layout.Row = 4;
    
    % Create results text
    statusText = uilabel(resultsPanel);
    statusText.Position = [10 10 150 80];
    statusText.Text = 'Ready to fetch data...';
    statusText.WordWrap = 'on';
    
    % Create plot panel
    plotPanel = uipanel(mainGrid, 'BackgroundColor', 'white', ...
        'Title', 'Temperature Trend Analysis', ...
        'FontWeight', 'bold');
    plotPanel.Layout.Row = [2 3];
    plotPanel.Layout.Column = [2 3];
    
    % Create grid layout for plot panel to properly size the axes
    plotGrid = uigridlayout(plotPanel, [1 1]);
    plotGrid.Padding = [10 10 10 10];
    
    % Create axes in the grid
    ax = uiaxes(plotGrid);
    ax.XGrid = 'on';
    ax.YGrid = 'on';
    ax.GridColor = [0.8 0.8 0.8];
    ax.GridAlpha = 0.3;
    ax.FontSize = 11;
    
    function fetchData(~,~)
        try
            % Get location coordinates
            coords = getLocationCoords(locationDropdown.Value);
            
            % Update status
            statusText.Text = 'Fetching data...';
            statusText.FontColor = [0.3 0.3 0.3];
            drawnow;
            
            % Fetch data
            baseURL = 'https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast';
            url = [baseURL, '?latitude=', coords.lat, '&longitude=', coords.lon, ...
                  '&hourly=temperature_2m&past_days=7&timezone=auto'];
            data = webread(url);
            
            % Process data
            time = datetime(data.hourly.time, 'InputFormat', 'yyyy-MM-dd''T''HH:mm');
            temp = data.hourly.temperature_2m;
            
            % Perform regression using chosen polynomial order
            hoursElapsed = hours(time - time(1));
            % Read requested polynomial order from spinner
            order = round(orderSpinner.Value);
            % Validate order against available data points
            nPoints = numel(hoursElapsed);
            if order >= nPoints
                % Cannot fit polynomial of degree >= nPoints
                statusText.Text = sprintf('Error: Order must be < %d (data points).', nPoints);
                statusText.FontColor = [0.6350 0.0780 0.1840];
                return
            end
            % Fit polynomial of requested order
            p = polyfit(hoursElapsed, temp, order);
            yFit = polyval(p, hoursElapsed);
            
            % Update plot
            cla(ax);
            hold(ax, 'on');
            
            % Plot data points
            scatter(ax, time, temp, 30, [0 0.4470 0.7410], 'filled', ...
                'DisplayName', 'Actual Temperature', ...
                'MarkerFaceAlpha', 0.6);
            
            % Plot trend line
            plot(ax, time, yFit, 'r-', 'LineWidth', 2, ...
                'DisplayName', 'Linear Trend');
            
            hold(ax, 'off');
            
            % Customize plot
            title(ax, ['Temperature Trend: ' locationDropdown.Value], 'FontSize', 14);
            xlabel(ax, 'Time', 'FontSize', 12);
            ylabel(ax, 'Temperature (°C)', 'FontSize', 12);
            legend(ax, 'Location', 'best', 'FontSize', 11);
            
            % Calculate statistics
            % For polynomial fit, report leading coefficient as general trend indicator
            leadingCoeff = p(1);
            r = corrcoef(temp, yFit);
            r2 = r(1,2)^2;

            % Update results (include polynomial order)
            statusText.Text = sprintf(['Location: %s\n' ...
                'Poly Order: %d\n' ...
                'Leading Coeff: %.4g\n' ...
                'R² = %.3f\n' ...
                'Mean Temp: %.1f°C'], ...
                locationDropdown.Value, order, leadingCoeff, r2, mean(temp));
            
            % Color code trend
            if slope > 0
                statusText.FontColor = [0.4660 0.6740 0.1880];
            elseif slope < 0
                statusText.FontColor = [0.6350 0.0780 0.1840];
            else
                statusText.FontColor = [0.3 0.3 0.3];
            end
            
        catch ME
            statusText.Text = 'Error: Could not fetch or process data.';
            statusText.FontColor = [0.6350 0.0780 0.1840];
            fprintf('Error: %s\n', ME.message);
        end
    end
end

function coords = getLocationCoords(location)
    % Get coordinates for a given location
    switch location
        case 'London'
            coords.lat = '51.5085';
            coords.lon = '-0.1257';
        case 'Paris'
            coords.lat = '48.8566';
            coords.lon = '2.3522';
        case 'New York'
            coords.lat = '40.7128';
            coords.lon = '-74.0060';
        case 'Tokyo'
            coords.lat = '35.6762';
            coords.lon = '139.6503';
    end
end
